name: CDK Source Connector Compatibility Test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  source-connector-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Detect relevant changes
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          base: ${{ github.base_ref || github.ref }}
          filters: |
            base:
              - 'airbyte-cdk/**'
            extract:
              - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/**'

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Cache pip packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install -r airbyte-cdk/requirements.txt

      - name: Run source connector tests
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.extract == 'true' || steps.filter.outputs.base == 'true' }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          for connector in $(./tools/bin/bulk-cdk/get-certified-connectors.sh sources); do
            echo "Running tests for $connector"
            pushd airbyte-integrations/connectors/$connector
            pytest -m "source" --junitxml=../../test-results/${connector}.xml
            popd
          done

      - name: Upload test results to Codecov
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.extract == 'true' || steps.filter.outputs.base == 'true' }}
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: test-results

      - name: Publish test results
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.extract == 'true' || steps.filter.outputs.base == 'true' }}
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: Source Connector Tests
          path: test-results/*.xml
          reporter: java-junit
